migrations.name: core-0005_identity_providers.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions_expiry ON oa_oidc_transactions(expires_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

migrations.sql:
-- One-time owner sign-in links minted by `rer signin` with the deployment's own
-- Cloudflare credentials, written straight into this table through the D1 API.
-- Apply as a NEW numbered migration under the seed's next unused number; never
-- rewrite an applied migration. Additive only. token_hash is the SHA-256 of the
-- link token (owner-signin-grant.mjs); the token itself is never stored.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_owner_signins (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id), operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, consumed_at INTEGER
);

-- HND-047: exact native person, installation audit only. All times are epoch milliseconds.
-- One-hour UI suggestion and a hard 24-hour ceiling are conservative pending CT duration guidance.
CREATE TABLE hnd_audit_access (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision=1),
 scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope='installation-audit'),
 person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id),
 person_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(person_version>0),
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id),
 owner_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(owner_version>0),
 allow_read INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(allow_read=1),
 allow_export INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(allow_export IN (0,1)),
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 revoked_at INTEGER,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 CHECK(expires_at>created_at AND expires_at<=created_at+86400000),
 CHECK(revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at>=created_at)
);
CREATE INDEX hnd_audit_access_person ON hnd_audit_access(person_id,revoked_at,expires_at);
-- Authority is immutable. A change requires a new capability; only first revocation is allowed.
CREATE TRIGGER hnd_audit_access_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON hnd_audit_access
 WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.revision IS NOT OLD.revision OR NEW.scope IS NOT OLD.scope
 OR NEW.person_id IS NOT OLD.person_id OR NEW.person_version IS NOT OLD.person_version
 OR NEW.created_by IS NOT OLD.created_by OR NEW.owner_version IS NOT OLD.owner_version
 OR NEW.allow_read IS NOT OLD.allow_read OR NEW.allow_export IS NOT OLD.allow_export
 OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
 OR (OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NOT OLD.revoked_at)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_audit_access'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER hnd_audit_access_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON hnd_audit_access
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'retain_audit_access'); END;

-- A promise remains open after delivery. Only an owning-system state read,
-- explicit decline, or owned escalation can settle it. No customer sends here.
CREATE TABLE hnd_followups (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, case_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES hnd_cases(id),
 source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES hnd_records(id), source_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 case_version INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id),
 owner_version INTEGER NOT NULL, obligation TEXT NOT NULL, due_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 confirmation_basis TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, draft TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, approved_revision INTEGER, approved_by TEXT,
 approved_owner_version INTEGER, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'
 CHECK(status IN ('open','confirmed','declined','escalated','canceled')),
 delivery TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'
 CHECK(delivery IN ('draft','approved','sending','received','uncertain','held','canceled')),
 operation_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, readback TEXT CHECK(readback IS NULL OR json_valid(readback)),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', next_due_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE hnd_followup_history (
 id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES hnd_followups(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL,

);
